Landing.heroLead: Names, logos, a palette, typography, a brand story, a live website and a social kit — generated together from a single brief, so they actually match.
Landing.briefValueBusiness: A specialty coffee bar for people who come to work
Landing.manifestLead: One run, start to finish. Everything below is real output from the brief above — not a mockup.
Landing.itemLogosNote: PNG and traced SVG, plus favicon, avatars and a monochrome mark
Landing.itemWebsiteNote: multi-page, editable, published on its own address
Landing.itemSocialNote: nine posts, bios, stories, hashtags and ad copy
Landing.coherenceTitle: It matches because it was decided once.
Landing.coherenceBody: Most tools give you a logo, then leave you to guess the rest. Every artifact here came out of the same brand decision in the same run, so the site, the posts and the mark are already the same brand.
Landing.editBody: Say what you want different and it regenerates — with every earlier version kept, so you can go back. Edit the website in the builder, or ask the assistant to adjust the brand.
Landing.arabicTitle: Arabic that was written in Arabic.
Landing.arabicBody: Brief it in Arabic and the model works in Arabic from the start. Naming, idiom and rhythm do not survive translation, so we do not translate.
Landing.closingBody: The free plan generates a full identity. No card.
Landing.badge: One brief in. A whole brand out.
Landing.pricingLead: Start free. Upgrade when you need more brands, more credits, or your own domain.
Landing.pricingAll: Every plan includes the full brand identity — names, logos, palette, typography and brand story.
